period_note: Unaudited interim financial performance, Jan-Mar 2026 (Q1). Sourced LIVE from DSE's company page (not a Wayback capture - this is the page's current content), fetched 2026-08-27 via curl -k (TLS chain issue on dsebd.org's certificate required -k/--insecure, same workaround already documented elsewhere in this dataset for NCCBANK). MAJOR RISK SIGNAL: this is a sharp reversal from consistently positive quarterly EPS across every quarter recovered for 2020-2025 (ranging +0.07 to +0.49 BDT/share) to a large per-share LOSS. At the 941,262,318 shares outstanding shown on the same DSE page (paid-up capital BDT 9,412.62mn, face value BDT 10), basic EPS of -8.120 implies an approximate quarterly net loss on the order of BDT -7,643 million (~-764 crore) - flagged as a new risk_signal in insights.json. This BDT figure is a derived approximation (basic EPS x current share count) marked accordingly, not a directly reported profit/loss figure - DSE's page does not show a profit-in-BDT figure for this quarter (same suppression as every quarter from 2023 onward, see 2023_Q1.json). Solo basis presumed per the same caveat as 2020_Q1.json. No FY2025 annual data, and no FY2026 balance-sheet data of any kind, exists elsewhere in this dataset - this and 2026_Q2.json are this dataset's only signal for either period.
